problems: The blind guess (a boxy wireframe near upper left with a long spike running down-right) does not identify a ladder. It reads as a kite or rocket, so the figure does not communicate 'Cliff Ladder' even though the title is correct.
The rungs are crammed into a tiny cluster around (142-222, 190-275). Three rungs and the two bends are almost on top of each other, so no rung structure reads as a ladder.

The rails form one long diagonal from the top-left star (21281 at about 84,132) to the foot star (17678 at about 232,434), with a short kink to the right. The figure reads as a triangle or spike, not a ladder hung from a cliff.
Labels are clipped and overlap each other and the stars (e.g. 'first rung just below the cl', 'lower rung, left end on the', 'outward bend i'), so the part each star is meant to mark cannot be read.
Several key stars sit on or next to the label text, and the outward-bend star (around 222,274) is not visibly distinct from the rung junctions.
Gold and blue strokes run side by side along every segment, so the figure looks like a doubled outline of the gold lines rather than a silhouette with its own shape.
Orientation is acceptable: the cliff anchor is at the top and the loose foot hangs at the bottom with empty sky below, so the figure is not upside down.
Many unlabelled background stars are scattered to the right of the figure. They are not part of the subject, but they make the empty area look like a second, unrelated constellation.
output.advice: Redraw so the ladder reads as a ladder. (1) Spread the rungs. Place the three rungs (19921 first rung just below the cliff, 19780 lower-left bend, 18744 lower-right, 18772 third rung on the right rail) at clearly separated heights along the rails, roughly evenly spaced in y, instead of stacking them in the 140-225 px band. (2) Keep the two rails roughly parallel and make them clearly two lines. Currently the left rail runs straight from 21281 to 17678 and the right rail is compressed; widen the gap between them so the ladder reads as a ladder, not a spike. (3) Hang the ladder from the cliff: put 21281 at the top, with a short horizontal 'cliff-nail' tie, and place 17440 as an outward kink on the right rail below the top. (4) Let 17678 (the foot) hang lower with open space below it, as the brief says. (5) Move labels so they don't clip or overlap stars, using leader lines or spacing them out to the sides. (7) Reduce unrelated background stars in the figure's empty area, or keep them out of the way."]
